game_title: Doubling Growth – Mine Cart Tunnel Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the mine cart fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the mine cart fast. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the size value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the mine cart using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the mine cart is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Doubling Growth
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Doubling Growth' (Week 4 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mine Cart Tunnel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 12.
